in_arabic.name: معاذ
in_arabic.long_meaning: The name Muadz is derived from the Arabic word 'ادع' (id'a'), which means 'to call, invite, or summon'. It is also said to be a reference to the Prophet Muhammad's companion, Muadh ibn Jabal, who was sent to Yemen to call the people to Islam.

in_urdu.name: معاض
in_urdu.long_meaning: The name Muadz in Urdu is written as 'معاض'. The meaning of the name is 'جلوس دینیات بوجود برندے' (jalsa diniyat bojood barnde), which translates to 'summoners of religions'. It is a powerful name that signifies the importance of spreading the message of Islam and inviting others to the faith.

in_hindi.name: मूढ़
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Muadz in Hindi is written as 'मूढ़'. The meaning of the name is 'जल्दी से जल्दी दिन पहुँचाना' (jaldi se jaldi din pahuchana), which translates to 'rushing towards the religion'. This name signifies the eagerness and enthusiasm of a person to embrace their faith and spread its teachings.

in_pashto.name: موضون
in_pashto.long_meaning: The name Muadz in Pashto is written as 'موضون'. The meaning of the name is 'دین به دلوز دادنده' (din beh daloz dadande), which translates to 'one who gives religion freely'. It is a name that signifies generosity and the selfless act of sharing one's faith with others.
